title: DPI - Decentralized Payments Interface
tagline: We are the  web3 UPI,No Gas, No Complexity ,Simplest UX , One Address for any chain.
description:
For an average anon to use crypto for daily use is a nightmare.
That's where we bring our simplest UX platform with zero gas and single address for any chain
to make people's assets safer, secure and transactions more resiliant than ever before.
how_its_made: Finding the right parameters to hash for geneating typehash and serializing the input data was one of the biggest challege we faced in designing in the smart wallets.We used determinitic address detection to find the address of the smart contract that would be deployed on demand by a user bearing a certain public key.We had to revise and brainstrom on EIP712 to get the right understanding.The second chanllege was dealing with Li-Fi protocol which served most of our utility purpose that can show all the possible use cases of smart wallets which eventually eneded up uncompactable.We had verify EIP 4337 and were successfully able to build a implementation which is very secure and abstracted at various levels.
